Brand system · Version 1

Made for your kind of Japan.

Expressive travel energy, balanced with calm, practical guidance. Preserve the suitcase, oversized DIY lettering, and raspberry signature as the recognizable core.

Logo rules

Use the refined mint-backed master as a compact brand badge. The supplied transparent original remains available for flexible backgrounds. Keep clear space of at least one suitcase-handle height around it. Preserve aspect ratio, white letter interiors, and original colors. Do not stretch, rotate, add shadows, or place it over busy photographs. Use the full signature at 116 pixels wide or larger; the detailed mark needs a separately designed compact icon for small favicons.

Download refined logo PNG →

Typography

Use Avenir Next where available, then Segoe UI and Arial/system sans-serif for a consistent editorial and interface hierarchy. No external font request is required. Use native CJK system fonts for Chinese. Body text starts at 17 pixels with generous line spacing. Avoid all-caps treatments for long translations.

Actions and accessibility

Raspberry buttons use white text. Use one prominent next step per section and concrete verbs: Choose my trip length, Save my plan, Compare routes. Keep targets at least 44 pixels high, visible keyboard focus, and text alternatives for images. Never rely on color alone for status.

Photography and illustration

Favor relevant food details, human-scale streets, and seasonal landscapes with a clear subject. Use licensed or original real-location photos for destination evidence. Label AI illustrations clearly and never imply they document a real visit. Reserve calm space around headlines and buttons.

Voice and trust

Be welcoming, specific, and helpful. State trade-offs, review dates, and source limitations. Avoid false urgency, invented reviews, universal best claims, and guaranteed rankings.

Languages

English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Filipino/Tagalog, Indonesian and Malay cover the pages, planner and portal. Language selection preserves the current page. Translations still need native editorial review. Language is not inferred from nationality or location.

Before public release

Obtain native-speaker review, complete visual desktop/mobile QA, and review the provisional D favicon and final vector masters. Current private pages remain noindex.
